title: VM Call/Return with frames
description:
Implement Call and update Return for frame-based execution.

Files: src/virtual_machine.rs

Stack layout during call:
[..., closure, arg0, arg1, arg2]
       ^                      ^
       stack_base             stack top

Why closure stays on stack: It occupies slot 0 of the called function's window. stack_base points here. On return, stack.truncate(stack_base) cleans up everything.

Why clone() in Call: Value is Copy (8 bytes), so .clone() is cheap. Can't move from Vec since value must stay. Makes intent explicit.

Tasks:
- Implement call_closure(closure_idx, arg_count) -> Result:
  - Validate arity matches arg_count
  - Check frame_count < MAX_FRAMES
  - Calculate stack_base = stack.len() - arg_count - 1
  - Push new CallFrame(closure, ip=0, stack_base)
- Implement return_from_function(return_value) -> bool:
  - Pop frame
  - Call close_upvalues(frame.stack_base)
  - Truncate stack to stack_base
  - Push return_value
  - Return frame_count == 0 (script complete)
- Update Opcode::Call handler:
  - Read arg_count from operand
  - Get callee from stack (closure stays, use clone)
  - Match on Value::Closure and call call_closure()
  - Error on non-callable
- Update Opcode::Return handler:
  - Pop result
  - Call close_upvalues for frame
  - Call return_from_function()
  - If returns true, exit interpret loop

title: End-to-end testing for functions
description:
Create comprehensive tests for functions and closures.

Files: end2end/*.jsonnet, src/*_test.rs

Test cases:
- Simple function call: (function(x) x + 1)(5) => 6
- Multiple parameters: (function(a, b) a + b)(1, 2) => 3
- Closure capturing local: local x = 10; (function(y) x + y)(5) => 15
- Nested closures: (function(x) function(y) x + y)(1)(2) => 3
- Closure escaping scope: 
  local makeAdder = function(x) function(y) x + y;
  local add5 = makeAdder(5);
  add5(3) => 8
- Multiple closures sharing upvalue:
  local x = 10;
  local f = function() x;
  local g = function() x + 1;
  f() + g() => 21
- Higher-order functions:
  local apply = function(f, x) f(x);
  apply(function(n) n * 2, 5) => 10

Unit tests:
- Upvalue capture and close mechanics
- Frame management (push/pop)
- GC with live closures
- Stack overflow detection (MAX_FRAMES)

title: VM GetUpvalue/CloseUpvalue implementation
description:
Implement upvalue access and closing opcodes.

Files: src/virtual_machine.rs

Tasks:
- Implement capture_upvalue(stack_slot) -> UpvalueIndex:
  - Walk open_upvalues linked list
  - If upvalue for slot exists, return it
  - Otherwise create new ManagedUpvalue with stack_location = Some(slot)
  - Insert into list (sorted by stack position descending)
- Implement close_upvalues(last_slot):
  - Walk open_upvalues from head
  - For upvalues at or above last_slot:
    - Copy stack[location] into closed_value
    - Set stack_location to None
    - Remove from open list
- Add Opcode::GetUpvalue handler:
  - Read slot from operand
  - Get upvalue from current closure's upvalues[slot]
  - If open: push stack[location]
  - If closed: push closed_value
- Add Opcode::CloseUpvalue handler:
  - Call close_upvalues(stack.len() - 1)
  - Pop stack
